title: Lip-sync Human and Digital Avatar Workstream
summary: Evaluate lip-sync generation fidelity using voice cloning, temporal consistency checks, and face-mesh mapping on human avatars.

inputs.description: Draft request JSON for lip-sync avatar video submit including audio vid reference
